note: The earlier college football seasons (docs/design/college-football.md, "Earlier seasons"): the FBS seasons 2009 to 2025, computed from the facts sportsdataverse publishes (scripts/sync-cfb-seasons.mjs). `espn` is each school's ESPN team id, by which the sources name it; `schools` the FBS schools of those seasons the game's built-in season does not have (Idaho, FBS to 2017, whose rosters are too thin for it to field any season); `conferences` the sources' conference names as the game shows them; `venues` a school's stadium in the seasons it played most of its home games elsewhere than today; `maps` the era maps the seasons play on.

cfb-akron.note: ESPN names no venue for these seasons; their articles have every home game at the Rubber Bowl, before InfoCision Stadium opened on the campus in 2009.

cfb-cal.note: ESPN names no venue for the season; the season's article has five home games at AT&T Park, besides Fresno State at Candlestick Park, while California Memorial Stadium was rebuilt.

cfb-colorado-state.stadium: Sonny Lubick Field at Hughes Stadium
cfb-colorado-state.article: Sonny Lubick Field at Hughes Stadium

cfb-fau.note: ESPN names no venue for most of these seasons' home games; their articles have them at Lockhart Stadium, Fort Lauderdale, before FAU Stadium opened in 2011: three of 2008's four (the other at Dolphin Stadium) and all of 2009's and 2010's. (FAU played there from 2004 too, but its rebuilt rosters cannot field 2004–2007.)

cfb-fiu.note: ESPN names no venue for the season; its article has all five home games at the Orange Bowl, Miami, away from FIU Stadium.

cfb-hawaii.note: Aloha Stadium to 2020 (its last season, without spectators). ESPN also places three of 2021's home games there; the season's article has all six at the Clarence T. C. Ching Athletics Complex.

cfb-houston.note: TDECU Stadium was built on Robertson Stadium's site: the same point, under the name of the day.
ESPN names no venue for the season; its article has five home games at Reliant Stadium and two at BBVA Compass Stadium, between Robertson Stadium and TDECU Stadium.

cfb-kansas.note: ESPN flags every home game of the season as neutral: while David Booth Kansas Memorial Stadium was rebuilt, Kansas played four at Arrowhead Stadium, Kansas City, Missouri, and two at Children's Mercy Park, Kansas City, Kansas. The school keeps its town, Lawrence, and holds land of Missouri that season.

cfb-miami.note: ESPN names no venue for these seasons; their articles have every home game at the Orange Bowl, Miami, before Dolphin Stadium (Hard Rock Stadium) from 2008.

cfb-minnesota.note: ESPN names no venue for these seasons; their articles have every home game at the Metrodome, downtown Minneapolis, before TCF Bank Stadium (Huntington Bank Stadium) opened on the campus in 2009.

cfb-north-texas.note: ESPN names no venue for these seasons; their articles have every home game at Fouts Field, before Apogee Stadium (DATCU Stadium) opened in 2011.

cfb-northwestern.note: Five home games a season at Martin Stadium and two at Wrigley Field while Ryan Field was rebuilt on its site (ESPN flags all of 2024's as neutral). Ryan Field of 1926–2023 stands where today's does: no era.

cfb-sam-houston.note: ESPN flags every home game of the season as neutral: all five were at Shell Energy Stadium, Houston (ESPN's BBVA Compass Stadium). The school keeps its town, Huntsville.

cfb-san-diego-state.note: Qualcomm Stadium renamed on September 19, 2017, before five of that season's seven home games.

ESPN places these seasons' home games at Qualcomm Stadium (and four of 2021's at the StubHub Center): their articles have every one at Dignity Health Sports Park, Carson, while Snapdragon Stadium was built. The school keeps its town, San Diego.

cfb-tulane.note: Hurricane Katrina shut the Superdome for 2005, whose six home games were played at six grounds in Louisiana and Alabama, one each (the season's article): the map keeps the school at the Superdome. The Mercedes-Benz Superdome from late October 2011, when its new name went onto the stadium, after five of that season's six home games.

cfb-uab.note: No team in 2015 and 2016. ESPN also places three of 2021's home games at Legion Field; the season's article has all five at Protective Stadium, which opened with the first of them.

cfb-ucf.note: ESPN names no venue for these seasons; their articles have every home game at the Florida Citrus Bowl, Orlando, before Bright House Networks Stadium (the Bounce House) opened on the campus in 2007.

cfb-umass.note: Every home game at Gillette Stadium, Foxborough, in 2012 and 2013; three there and three at Warren McGuirk Alumni Stadium in each of 2014, 2015 and 2016, a tie the season before settles. The school keeps its town, Amherst.

cfb-washington.note: ESPN names no venue for the season; its article has all six home games at CenturyLink Field while Husky Stadium was rebuilt.
